hero_kpi_rationale: CoreWeave is fully dedicated to AI cloud infrastructure, making it the primary beneficiary of the HPC/AI wave. Its full-stack model (hardware, software, services) positions AI-related revenue as the main growth driver.

kpis.name: AI / Cloud Revenue Segment
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the cloud platform dedicated to AI workloads (training and inference).
kpis.description: CoreWeave offers only cloud services dedicated to AI, meaning all of its revenue is tied to this technological wave.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth driven by demand for AI infrastructure.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Infrastructure)
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical infrastructure, data centers, and equipment to support cloud capacity growth.
kpis.description: Deploying new data centers and acquiring next-generation GPUs require massive capex investments.
kpis.signal: Massive capex to meet demand for AI compute power.

kpis.name: Installed Power Capacity
kpis.explanation: Active electrical power available to run AI data centers.
kpis.description: Power availability is a major bottleneck for AI data centers; CoreWeave has increased its power capacity by more than 12x in two years (70 MW at end-2023, 360 MW at end-2024, 850 MW at end-2025).
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in power capacity, key to scaling AI infrastructure.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, reflecting the operational efficiency of the platform.
kpis.description: While fixed costs are high, software optimization and GPU density improve unit profitability.
kpis.signal: Improving gross margin driven by infrastructure optimization and scale.

kpis.name: R&D Intensity
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in total revenue.
kpis.description: CoreWeave is heavily investing in proprietary software (Mission Control, SUNK) to differentiate its platform.
kpis.signal: Sustained R&D to maintain technological edge, though slightly declining due to scale effects.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: The company is aggressively hiring in engineering, R&D, and data center operations.
kpis.signal: Rapid headcount growth to support technological and operational expansion.

kpis.name: Number of Data Centers
kpis.explanation: Total number of operational data centers hosting AI infrastructure.
kpis.description: Expansion from 10 data centers at end-2023 to 32 at end-2024, then to 43 at end-2025, supported by large-scale power contracts.
kpis.signal: Rapid physical expansion to meet demand for AI compute.

kpis.name: Contracted Power Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total electrical power under contract for future data center deployments.
kpis.description: With 3.1 GW under contract by end-2025, CoreWeave secures access to power, a key competitive advantage for multi-year growth.
kpis.signal: Massive power pipeline, ensuring future growth despite market constraints.

risks.title: Dependence on Energy Supply
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, listed first in Risk Summary and extensively discussed. Language is strong ('adversely affect', 'materially and adversely affected'). It directly impacts expansion and profitability. Industrial category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Critical Dependence on NVIDIA for GPUs
risks.score_rationale: Cited as a contractual obligation and major supply chain risk in Risk Summary. Purchase concentration historically high. Alarming language about inability to switch suppliers quickly. Competition category due to impact on technological flexibility.

risks.title: Risk of Dependence on a Few Suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Risk Summary: 'limited number of suppliers for significant components'. Well-documented recurring risk with high intensity. Less existential than energy or NVIDIA, but structural. Capital category as it affects costs and investment capacity.

risks.title: Loss of a Major Customer
risks.score_rationale: Positioned as a key risk. Strong language ('adversely affect'). Repeated over multiple years. Credit category as it directly impacts revenue and cash flow.

risks.title: High Leverage
risks.score_rationale: Very strong language ('materially adversely affect') expected in Risk Summary. Leverage limits financial flexibility, diverts cash flow to debt repayments. Capital category, heavily weighted.

risks.title: Intense Competition in AI Cloud
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Risk Summary. Structural risk in a high-growth sector. Standard language but in context of rising AI adoption. Central Competition category.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks in Supply Chain
risks.score_rationale: Growing risk linked to Taiwan-China tensions and access to semiconductors. Related to GPUs and critical components. Geopolitical category heavily weighted in current context.

ai_positioning.summary: CoreWeave is positioned entirely as a native AI cloud infrastructure platform. AI is central to its value proposition: accelerating training models, infrastructure optimized for inference workloads, and proprietary software (Mission Control, SUNK) designed specifically for AI. Growth is entirely driven by AI adoption.
evidence: Item 1 Business: 'purpose-built to accelerate breakthroughs by AI pioneers'
Platform: supports 'full lifecycle of AI, including large-scale model training, inference, data movement, continuous iteration, and agentic workflows'
Software: proprietary 'Mission Control' and 'SUNK' optimized for AI
MD&A: 'Adoption of AI in Society' is the first key performance factor
Clients: 'leading AI labs and enterprises', customers building 'foundational models'
